title: Family Relationship
description: Build stronger family bonds with better communication, quality time, and mutual support

goals.title: Improve Family Communication
goals.description: Have more open and positive family conversations

goals.title: Resolve Conflicts
goals.description: Address and work through family issues

habits.title: Family Meal
habits.description: Eat together at least once a day

habits.title: Check-In
habits.description: Ask family members about their day

habits.title: Express Appreciation
habits.description: Tell family members you appreciate them

tasks.title: Family Meeting
tasks.description: Have a meeting to discuss family matters

tasks.title: Learn Communication Skills
tasks.description: Practice better ways to talk and listen

tasks.title: Create Family Traditions
tasks.description: Start new family rituals or activities

warnings: Every family is different - find what works for yours
Consistency is more important than perfection
Respect individual differences within the family
Seek family therapy if conflicts are severe
fallback_message: I found a family relationship template! This plan will help you build stronger connections with your family.
